quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on his excitement about joining the Phoenix Suns
quotes.excerpt: I feel like we got a really good group and we're going to surprise a lot of people
quotes.quote: I'm feeling good. It feels like yesterday I just got traded here and now we're already in the season. I learned so much, met so many new people, so I'm excited. I feel like we got a really good group and we're going to surprise a lot of people this year.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges says he is excited about the Suns group and believes they are going to surprise a lot of people this year.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on the Suns' defensive-minded identity
quotes.excerpt: If we stay defensive-minded, the offense is going to figure itself out.
quotes.quote: Because we're a versatile group. Of course we hang our hats on defense, but we got a lot of offensive players that can put the ball in the hoop. So if we stay defensive-minded, the offense is going to figure itself out.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges says the Suns are hanging their hats on defense this season. He believes if they stay defensive minded the offense will figure itself out.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on adapting to the Suns' defensive schemes
quotes.excerpt: I haven't picked up full court since Michigan State, but if that's what the team needs
quotes.quote: I'm definitely comfortable. I haven't picked up full court since Michigan State, but if that's what the team needs for us to win, I'm down for it. That's the culture here, so I have to adapt to the culture.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges says he has not picked up full court since Michigan State but is ready to do it if the team needs it to win. He says that is the culture in Phoenix.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on the team's emphasis on forcing turnovers
quotes.excerpt: Some teams they like to play conservative, but we like to turn people over
quotes.quote: We like to force turnovers. Some teams they like to play conservative, just get a bad shot at the end of the shot clock, but we like to turn people over and get out in transition and run. That's my whole game.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges on the Suns defensive identity. He says they like to turn people over and get out in transition to run because that is his whole game.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on the competitiveness of the current NBA
quotes.excerpt: I feel like the league is the most balanced it's ever been.
quotes.quote: I feel like the league is the most balanced it's ever been. There's no way to just get that number one pick from losing, so everybody wants to win. I'm excited for the season.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges says the league is the most balanced it has ever been because there is no way to just get that number one pick from losing anymore.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on his goal to improve his passing
quotes.excerpt: I used to tell LaMelo I was a better passer, so this is my year to prove it.
quotes.quote: Hopefully. I used to tell LaMelo I was a better passer, so this is my year to prove it. And like I said, we got a lot of weapons, so I'm excited to play.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges says he used to tell LaMelo he was a better passer and this is his year to prove it.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on the impact of playing with a playmaker
quotes.excerpt: He's a maniac on the floor. He gets loose balls that he's not supposed to get.
quotes.quote: He's a maniac on the floor. He gets loose balls that he's not supposed to get, and he's consistent with it. So I'm happy to be playing with him.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges describes his teammate as a maniac on the floor who gets loose balls he is not supposed to get.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on the team's focus on offensive rebounding
quotes.excerpt: We've been trying to get $250 every time we get an offensive rebound on free throws.
quotes.quote: We've been trying to get $250 every time we get an offensive rebound on free throws. That's something that I did at Michigan State as well. I didn't do as much with the Hornets as offensive rebounding, so I'm excited to do that as well.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges says the Suns are emphasizing offensive rebounding on free throws this season. He noted he did not do as much of that with the Hornets.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on the coaching staff's philosophy on physicality
quotes.excerpt: They just want us to be physical no matter what. Don't pay attention to the refs.
quotes.quote: They just want us to be physical no matter what. Don't pay attention to the refs. Usually the most physical team gets the less calls during the game if you start off the game physical. That's the type of identity that we want to have.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges says the coaching staff wants the team to be physical no matter what. He believes the most physical team usually gets fewer calls against them if they start the game physical.
